rules.statement: Under the Tesawalamai, a father has the right to allocate his deceased wife's dowry property as dowry for his daughters upon their marriage.
rules.supporting_quote: "It appears to have been conceded in the Court below that each child took a fourth on the death of their mother, and on the other point the learned Judge held that under section 1, sub-section (11), it was allowed to the father to deal with his deceased wife's property in the way that he has done."
